rationale: The dominant room_swap->splice failures combine recur_frac>=0.9 with a non-null dup_dense_last_frame, but the dup_dense signal led with its timewarp reading, so I made the still-swap precedence explicit in both that signal and the typing guide (task/recur/echo now all name room_swap for that combo). Splice->none cases have no free-signal trace, so I only strengthened judging guidance (judge the top photo_jump peak before concluding none) rather than adding any new corruption trigger. The reverse->loop fix is deliberately minimal — one word in the echo caveat — to avoid the recurrence-band rule the prior proposal already showed breaks reverse and clean clips.

pack.task: Decide whether this 30s video clip was tampered with, and which candidates (if any) need a VLM continuity check.
pack.conclude_crit: stop gathering evidence and report the final verdict
pack.judge_crit_template: run the VLM continuity check on candidate {i} at frame {frame} (~{secs:.1f}s)

signals.recur_frac_max: fraction of frames that are near-exact replays of an earlier frame (lag 2-10s). A forward LOOP of moving footage replays the entire clip, so it scores >=0.9 with dup_dense_last_frame NULL. CAVEAT: a static motionless span (e.g. a still room swapped in) also scores ~1.0 — if dup_dense_last_frame is non-null the repeated region is a STILL => room_swap, not loop and not timewarp. If recur is high but only a partial span is replayed backward (echo_best_score>10) => reverse. Values 0.5-0.8 are ambiguous (same-scene splices reach ~0.6) and alone are NOT corruption evidence.
signals.dup_dense_last_frame: last frame of a dense run of adjacent-duplicate frames (a static/frozen or slowed stretch). Non-null together with recur_frac_max>=0.9 => the whole clip is a duplicated still scene swapped in => room_swap (NOT loop, NOT timewarp). Non-null with a NORMAL recur_frac_max (<0.9) => a local slowed/frozen stretch => timewarp. Null on clean, loop, splice, reverse.
signals.echo_best_score: self-anchored 4-factor score for a reversed segment: high only when TWO discontinuities echo each other (content after seam A matches content after seam B). >10 = strong reverse evidence; clean and other edits typically <3. NOTE: a forward loop also echoes, so echo>10 => reverse only when recur_frac_max is high but below 1.0 (a partial backward span); with recur~1.0 and dup_dense null it is a forward loop, and with dup_dense non-null it is room_swap. Two discontinuities WITHOUT high echo => room_swap or splice, not reverse.
signals.scenecut_iframe_frames: frames where the encoder inserted a scene-cut I-frame; flags abrupt visual discontinuity. BASE RATE: clean unedited clips average ~2-3 of these per 30s from natural motion, so a few are normal.
signals.photo_jump_top3: top frame-difference peaks. IMPORTANT: z is normalized WITHIN this clip, so the largest peak always scores high even on clean clips — read peak POSITIONS and co-occurrence with other signals, not z magnitude; a splice's whole signature is one sharp jump at the peak frame.

pack.typing_guide: Type from judge-confirmed discontinuities; free signals pick the type, checked in order: 1) dup_dense_last_frame non-null AND recur_frac_max>=0.9 => room_swap (the whole clip is a duplicated still scene swapped in) — never loop or timewarp here. 2) dup_dense_last_frame non-null AND recur_frac_max normal (<0.9) => timewarp (a local slowed/frozen stretch). 3) recur_frac_max>=0.9 with dup_dense null => forward loop of moving footage; EXCEPTION: if echo_best_score>10 and recur is below 1.0, a segment is replayed reversed => reverse. 4) echo_best_score>10 with recur below 0.9 => reverse. 5) TWO judge-confirmed discontinuities with echo<10 => room_swap. 6) ONE judge-confirmed discontinuity: use the VLM verdict on PLACE — the same scene/location across it (content jumps in time, place stays) => splice; the place visibly changes / a different room appears => room_swap. 7) No confirmed discontinuity + quiet signals => none.
pack.candidate_note: Each candidate is a suspicious transition the gates flagged. BASE RATE: the gates are permissive and nominate ~4-8 candidates per clip INCLUDING on clean unedited clips, so a candidate existing is weak evidence — only its VLM verdict is strong. A VLM check costs ~2s and is near-perfect precision. Splice edits leave NO free-signal trace, so quiet signals (low recur, dup_dense null, echo<3) do NOT rule out a splice. Before concluding none, judge the candidate at (or next to) the top photo_jump peak position and any scene-cut I-frame — a single sharp jump there is a splice's whole signature. If two separated peaks of comparable large z appear, judge both endpoints (leave-and-return => room_swap; a single seam => splice).

questions.action: What is the best next step?
questions.corrupted: This clip contains an artificial temporal discontinuity (an edit: replayed footage, reversed segment, swapped scene, cut/splice, or retimed segment).
questions.break_type: Which edit type best fits the evidence?
questions.sufficient: The current evidence is sufficient to conclude with confidence; more VLM checks would not change the verdict.
questions.is_type_template: The evidence indicates this clip was edited with a {type} corruption ({desc}).

type_desc.loop: footage repeats itself — a moving segment is replayed forward
type_desc.reverse: a segment plays backward in time
type_desc.room_swap: the scene/location changes to a DIFFERENT place then returns (a still/swapped-in scene counts); the PLACE differs across the seam
type_desc.splice: a hard cut joins non-contiguous footage of the SAME scene/location (content jumps in time, the place stays the same)
type_desc.timewarp: part of the clip plays at altered speed (slowed or sped up)
